pools.name: Ballard Pool Adjacent to Ballard High School. Features a 25-yard indoor pool with water slide, low dive, rope swing and warm water spa.
pools.blurb: Adjacent to Ballard High School. Features a 25-yard indoor pool with water slide, low dive, rope swing and warm water spa.

pools.name: Colman Pool A 50-meter, 8-lane Olympic sized heated saltwater pool in West Seattle’s Lincoln Park. Summer only.
pools.blurb: A 50-meter, 8-lane Olympic sized heated saltwater pool in West Seattle’s Lincoln Park. Summer only.
pools.season_note: Colman Pool is operating 7 days a week from June 13 to August 30 , including the July 4th holiday.

rows: Lap Swim (daily) and weekend Recreation Swim (Fri-Sun only)

pools.name: Queen Anne Pool CLOSED UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE. Queen Anne's 6-lane, 25-yard indoor pool has built-in steps for easy entry, 1m and 3m diving boards, rope swing and a sauna.
pools.blurb: CLOSED UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE. Queen Anne's 6-lane, 25-yard indoor pool has built-in steps for easy entry, 1m and 3m diving boards, rope swing and a sauna.

closure.heading: Queen Anne Pool will remain closed until fall 2027 due to a significant underground leak requiring major repair.
closure.note: A permanent fix will be completed as part of the Citywide Pool Renovation Project (future updates and timeline on this project will be shared on this website and in our Queen Anne Pool newsletter).
